# ApexVault
> Sovereign Multi-Agent Cryptographic Layer

## Overview
Build a high-performance dark glassmorphism SaaS landing page for ApexVault with Argon2id cryptographic sandbox, 3 pricing tiers, and audio chimes.

## Architecture & Tech Stack
- Target Framework: vite-react
- Theme: Obsidian Gold
- Compliance: WCAG 2.1 AA, OWASP Top 10 Hardened
- Synthesized By: Zoth Multi-Agent Swarm
